browser_e2e_reason: A local browser executable is unavailable; real Android screenshots supplied the visual evidence.
clinical_source: Université de Nantes 2017 p.17; C3/C2 81% ±2%, 0.25° per 2% variation.

tests: Every inline JavaScript block parses
A52 is built from the locked A51 checksum
C3/C2 keeps the real decimal measurement and applies a continuous correction
C3/C2 normal interval 79%-83% produces no correction
C3/C2 follows 0.25 degrees per two percentage points in both directions
The F1 evidence text separates real measurement from applied correction
Landmark radii and line widths are reduced without touching coordinates
Semaphore dots are five pixels and remain outside the radiograph
Portable JSON is nonempty and its Blob byte count is verified
Serialization errors stop the save instead of producing an empty file
Android uses a real File through native sharing when supported
Zero-byte imports report the actual cause and recovery action
A valid portable study JSON is read with a verified byte count
An analysis snapshot is explicitly distinguished from a resumable study
All non-height clinical functions remain byte-identical to A51
A52 exposes the clinical scope and the report/study distinction
a52.scope: C3/C2 continuity, subtle display, JSON bytes/Android sharing/import diagnostics, syntax and inherited formula regression; no browser E2E.

interaction.method: Node event-handler harness using delivered HTML; not browser end-to-end testing

tests.name: Placing a point after saving marks the study dirty
Dragging an unfrozen point after saving marks the study dirty
Placing calibration marker A after saving marks the study dirty
Calculating a new calibration after saving marks the study dirty
Panning without clinical edits does not mark the study dirty
Selecting a frozen point does not alter its coordinates

tests: All seven existing module routes are preserved
Craniofacial uses the in-app module and fixed remaining viewport height
Dirty state from an unrelated window is ignored
Dirty state from the wrong origin is ignored
Unsaved changes block navigation when the operator cancels
Explicit discard permits return to the selector and clears route layout
Synchronous dirty query closes the message delivery race
portal.method: Node DOM doubles; no browser or deployment
